children: Israel's annual inflation rate (ILCPIY=ECI) rose a less than expected 1.1% in October to a more than five-year low, data from the Central Bureau of Statistics showed on Sunday, a level that could fuel further interest rate cuts.
The October rate, its lowest since April 2021, was below expectations of 1.5% in a Reuters poll and is within the government's annual target range of 1% to 3%.
The consumer price index (ILCPI=ECI) fell 0.1% in October from September, versus expectations of a 0.3% rise.

The Bank of Israel next meets on interest rates on November 23. It has cut the key rate by 25 basis points at three of its last four decisions to 3.25%, leaving the rate unchanged at its prior meeting on October 21.
Central bank officials have said they could reduce the rate further should inflation remain contained.
